title: Ki Khanatang U Barim (Tales of the Ancients)
cultural_context: Recited by village bards around the hearth (*ka dpei*) passing down ancestral genealogy and moral wisdom.

khasi: Sngap ko khun samla ia ka khanatang,
Ba ki tymmen barim ki la buh ryntih,
Ha ki mawbynna ba ieng ha shnong,
Ha ka ktien ba phyrnai kaba ngi ieit.
english: Listen, O youthful children, to the ancient tales,
Which the elders of old arranged in order,
Upon the upright megaliths standing in the village,
In the radiant language that we hold dear.

lyrics_khasi:
